entries.1dd8c87c4cfd2854: This division manages and operates all FC stores and directly operated stores. At FC stores, it provides a call center open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, remote support via monitoring cameras, and daily inspection and cleaning, and receives management income from the sales collected monthly. entries.f85b023b9b2edaab: This business sells facilities such as hotels using container houses and is entrusted with their management and operation. It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary WASH House Sustainable Co., Ltd., and in June 2025 it opened the trailer hotel '1NLDK' in Aoshima, Miyazaki City and Kanagahama, Hyuga City. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is ¥402 million.
